en: A vintage monochrome postcard featuring a stone funerary monument showing a large sculpted bull standing on a rectangular base. The bull is depicted in profile, walking, on top of what appears to be a grave monument. Beneath the image there is printed bilingual text in Greek and French identifying the subject as a tomb with a bull in Athens. Postal marks and some handwriting are visible on the right side, and there is a small publisher's mark and number at the bottom.
